statement.zh: 教科文将拉帕努伊国家公园列入世界遗产，强调波利尼西亚纪念性石雕与礼仪景观（UNESCO 715）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Rapa Nui National Park as World Heritage, emphasizing Polynesian monumental stone sculpture and ritual landscape (UNESCO 715).
